USING IMPERIO ACROSS DIFFERENT NETWORKS  (free, no server to pay for)
=====================================================================

The one-click bats work when both PCs are on the SAME Wi-Fi/router.
To connect two PCs on DIFFERENT networks (home <-> office, you <-> a
relative), the easiest free way is a free mesh VPN that puts both PCs on
one private network. Then Imperio works exactly like on the same Wi-Fi.

Recommended: TAILSCALE (free for personal use, 2 minutes to set up).

STEP 1 - install Tailscale on BOTH PCs
  - Go to  https://tailscale.com/download  , install, and sign in with the
    SAME account (Google/Microsoft/email) on both PCs.
  - That's it - both PCs are now on one private network.

STEP 2 - run Imperio as usual
  - On the HOST PC: run  1-START-HOST.bat
    It now shows a line like:
        Address : 100.101.102.103:7700   (VPN / Tailscale - works from other networks)
    Use THAT address (the 100.x one), not the 192.168.x one.
  - On the VIEWER PC: run  2-START-VIEWER.bat
    Enter that 100.x address and the Code. Done - works from anywhere.

Notes
  - If the host does NOT show a 100.x line, Tailscale isn't running on it -
    open the Tailscale app and make sure it's connected, then re-run the host.
  - You can also find a PC's Tailscale address by opening the Tailscale app,
    or running:  tailscale ip -4
  - ZeroTier is a free alternative to Tailscale and works the same way.

Why not "just connect over the internet" directly?
  Both PCs sit behind home routers that hide their real address, so they
  can't find each other without help. A paid option is to run the included
  imperio-signal.exe on a cheap VPS or a port-forwarded router - but the VPN
  above is free and simpler, so start there.
